name: Tokaj Wine Region Historic Cultural Landscape
description: In the foothills of northeastern Hungary, the Tokaj region weaves vineyards, farms and small villages across low hills and river valleys. Beneath the towns runs a hidden network of deep, cool cellars where the wine matures. This is the home of Tokaji aszú, the world's oldest botrytized wine, whose production has been strictly regulated for nearly three centuries.
